group.leave: What you get when you leave

sanjae.name: Work injury insurance
sanjae.line: Care and pay if hurt at work
sanjae.detail: If you get hurt or sick from work, you get medical costs and pay. All workers are covered automatically, whatever the visa.

geonbo.name: Health insurance
geonbo.detail: You join automatically when you work for a company. You pay much less at hospitals and pharmacies.
geonbo.payer: You and your company pay half each.

goyong1.name: Employment insurance (training)
goyong1.detail: You can get job training, and support to keep your job when the company has problems. You join automatically.

goyong2.name: Employment insurance (unemployment benefits)
goyong2.line: Join if you apply · Money if you lose your job
goyong2.detail: Apply if you want to join. Then you pay a fee, and you can get job-seeking pay if you lose your job. If you do not apply, you cannot get it.
goyong2.payer: You and your company pay together.

sanghae.name: Accident insurance (foreigners only)
sanghae.line: If hurt or sick outside work
sanghae.detail: Covers accidents, illness or death outside work. Foreign workers must join.

gongje.name: Migrant Workers' Mutual Fund
gongje.line: Account in your name · Get it all back when you leave
gongje.detail: Each month your contribution ({{worker}}%) and the company contribution ({{employer}}) go into an account in your name. You get it all back when you leave Korea. If you change to a long-term stay, it moves to the National Pension. This system is still a proposal.
gongje.payer: You and your company pay together.

chulguk.name: Departure guarantee insurance
chulguk.detail: Your company saves {{rate}}% of your pay each month. You get it as severance pay when you leave. It is separate from the Fund.

gwiguk.name: Return cost insurance
gwiguk.detail: You pay a set amount soon after your work contract starts. You claim it back when you leave.

nps_on.name: National Pension
nps_on.line: Joined · Hard to get a pension
nps_on.detail: You pay into it, but you must pay for over {{years}} years to get a pension. That is hard on your visa, so many people get their payments back at once when they leave (lump-sum refund).
nps_on.payer: You and your company pay half each.
nps_on.where: National Pension Service (claim the lump-sum refund when you leave)

nps_off.name: National Pension
nps_off.detail: People from your country cannot join the National Pension. So now no money is saved for your old age. The Fund is a proposal to fill this gap.

janggi.name: Long-term care insurance
janggi.line: Rarely used · You can ask to opt out
janggi.detail: This is for elderly care, so short-stay workers rarely benefit. You can apply to opt out.
janggi.payer: You and your company pay it with health insurance.

help.title: Help
help.a1: While you work, you and your company put a little into an account in your name each month. You get it all back when you leave Korea. This system is still a proposal.
help.q2: Is the money my company added mine too?
help.a2: Yes. Money your company added goes into your account, and you get it when you leave.
help.a3: Your account stays the same. Your time in the Fund keeps counting, so the company contribution does not go down.
help.q4: When do I get the money?
help.a4: Request in the app before you leave. After we check your departure, we send the money to your chosen account.
